findings.disposition_rationale: Step 11's REGION_MAP-only trigger is the spec's Chosen procedure and the map is pinned by design. For this PR the tip moved to 8f9b5b05 (FAFF-588, FAFF-740), which touched no cited module; the smoke test re-run with the tip as the reference commit passes steps 2-8 (step 1 fails only because the header names the pin, as intended).

The map's completeness claim is relative to its pin (b02fac1b), not live main. A CI test equating the classification table with live REGION_MAP would force a map revision into every PR that adds a command, a policy the spec did not choose and that its test-change limit excludes. Recorded as vague discovered scope.
Step 3 now records the fixture's sha256, asserted by the test, so the check reproduces at any commit that carries the revision (cf7626c0).
Step 4 now states that the member count is the check, whatever the RESULT line's pass/fail word (cf7626c0).
Grep found the bare reproduce command in the banked report.md and protocol.md; the coupling finding now names them and why they stay unedited (cf7626c0). The follow-up covers them.
